riskSignals.claim: Contract follows an EIP-1967 proxy pattern with a separate implementation and admin; logic can be changed by the admin
Token has an owner address (0x6a8e2b2134b7b52c24a1448ad6be5c669eaa501a) and a proxy admin (0x1e33d209c18f51d97f66ea461c6f819b59e78b30) whose privileges and key custody are unknown
Current proxy bytecode does not expose mint/pause selectors, but because the implementation is upgradeable these protections can be removed or altered without user consent
Contract is on BNB Testnet and has only 1 on-chain transaction as of the latest observed block
Reported total supply is large (≈10.00525 billion U with 18 decimals)

report.recommendation: Treat this contract as high-risk, especially for any real value. The EIP-1967 proxy structure means the logic and token controls can be changed by the proxy admin/owner without notice. Do not rely on the current absence of mint/pause selectors as a guarantee. This is a BNB Testnet contract with minimal on-chain activity and no native balance; use it for testing only, and perform additional due diligence on the implementation contract and admin key custody before any interaction.
limitations: Historical state at the required comparison block (128449782) is largely unavailable because the RPC node has pruned state prior to block 128449783.
Latest-state measurements are not substituted for the unavailable historical state; they are reported separately.
This analysis is based solely on direct read-only RPC observations and does not include holder, liquidity, sellability, or source-code verification data.
No off-chain intelligence, reputation scoring, or manual contract review was performed.
The operator was automated and is not represented as an independent human.
The baseline did not measure holder concentration, PancakeSwap liquidity, recent transfers, or executed sellability.
USD cost is a token-list-price estimate because the provider response did not expose invoice-level cost.
